findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false. Long-lived key material without automatic annual rotation increases the impact window if the key is ever compromised and violates common compliance baselines for audit log keys.

No explicit key policy is attached, so AWS applies the default policy granting the account root full kms:* access, which delegates key permissions to any IAM principal in the account with sufficient IAM permissions. For a key protecting audit trail data this fails least privilege and provides no separation of duties between key administrators and log readers/deleters.
